title: CouponsWatchMatchedPayload
description: coupons.watch.matched v1 (OpenVibe.Coupons server/domain/watches.js notifyWatchers). A code for a merchant a person watches became publicly listed (created published, or approved from review), inside the same transaction. One event per (watcher, coupon): never for the person who submitted the code, never twice. Internal visibility, the envelope subject is the coupon; recipient is who OpenVibe.Network notifies. The payload carries no code text: the notification links the coupon page, where its restrictions and reports are.

recipient.description: The watcher's user subject id: who is notified.

title.description: The code's title as listed (what it gives).

expires_at.description: The stated expiry (ISO date or date-time), or null when unknown.
